## Body

PASS-WITH-NOTES, round 1, performance/334, exact head 8f705b4ee8308018e235f2c64ed77912e3bc8133.

No blocking performance finding. The added work launches no process per tick or per seat. No daemon bounce, live-seat restart or live-seat typing was performed; the detached review worktree remains unchanged.

Cost verified from source:

- The existing delivery drain defaults to a 5 s cadence (crates/core/src/config.rs:213; crates/daemon/src/lib.rs:1269-1270,1369-1371). drain_once removes a live recipient's kind after one claim in a pass (crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs:251-309). New work runs only for a claimed Copilot control, not for every idle Copilot seat. Holds retain durable exponential retry_delay: 1,2,4,...,300 s, with the queue's attempt/not-before persisted (crates/daemon/src/pointer/mod.rs:105-117; worker.rs:951-965). The cadence is nominal: receiver-deadline wakes also exist. The durable not-before, not an assumed 5 s minimum, bounds retries.
- Each such claim adds one logical latest-receiver-edge lookup (worker.rs:419-426). The real store performs two indexed seeks, one for each receiver kind, in one read transaction, with its existing schema check. LATEST_MATCHING_SQL explicitly names spine_by_seat_kind(seat,kind,seq), so it does not walk unrelated seat history (crates/store/src/spine.rs:59-65,367-395; migrations/0020_spine_by_seat_kind.sql:2).
- For a lapsed seat, the busy brake replaces published-state checks with one visible-pane capture when held, or two captures 250 ms apart when the first is Idle (worker.rs:537-569). Capture/classification scales with visible pane rows/bytes, not scrollback. A continuously busy lapsed seat therefore adds one launch-free capture per due control claim; at the retry ceiling, approximately one per 300 s per such seat. Idle settlement can add 250 ms per qualifying seat to the serial drain pass, as the existing settled-state brake already did. A failed edge read conservatively runs both brakes.
- fresh_turn calls only capture_without_launch (auth_recovery.rs:226-231). The real adapter calls query_live, which uses ask(args,false); without a live client it returns None before start(), and a failed/lost client is not restarted by this call (crates/tmux/src/lib.rs:1286-1294; control.rs:537-541,576-585). This path never falls back to a forked capture. Unreadable holds. The spawn-site sensor includes daemon, harnesses, store and tmux; no new launch site is required. An eventual /restart still uses the existing counted staged-control submission launches: zero is the incremental screen-read launch cost, not an end-to-end restart launch count.
- F261 adds one launch-free pane capture only when an undecided lapse can act (auth_recovery.rs:358-362,539-563). Busy then queues the existing restart control and tells the same parent/primes the old notify path told. The existing follower is event-driven, with attachment/gap reconciliation, not a new timer or subscription per seat.
- Duplicate suppression adds no timer: the 60 s grace is checked on existing claims. Memory is one entry per distinct Copilot seat whose lapsed restart was let through during this daemon lifetime, including subsequently retired seats; it does not grow per retry (worker.rs:158-162,581-604).

Non-blocking cost note: restart_overtaken also calls latest_matching_message for a restart whose latest edge is renewal, before the busy brake (worker.rs:424-429,613-638). Its arguments are keyed, but its SQL is NOT an indexed msg_id seek: json_extract(payload,'$.msg_id') is a residual filter and no matching expression index is present (crates/store/src/spine.rs:397-418). A synthetic in-memory run of the exact SQL with the repository's three spine indexes and ANALYZE read progressively more history: 1,000/10,000/100,000 newer same-seat delivery.outcome rows took 0.248/2.065/18.787 ms and approximately 8,000/80,000/800,000 VM instructions. SQLite 3.54.1 chose SCAN spine_events in that single-seat fixture. These are synthetic warm-memory numbers, not deployed timings. Normal newly queued controls have recent admission outcomes; a found overtaken control closes immediately, and held claims back off. This is not a demonstrated normal-use cost breach. Do not describe this additional message lookup as constant-cost merely because the receiver-edge lookup is indexed; a bounded/indexed admission-outcome lookup is an optional follow-up candidate.
